_comment: The association's calendar, and the only file edited to change it. ONE row per event,
both languages side by side, exactly like i18n/strings.json.
This file is a BOX. Every text field has a hard length range and i18n/events.py refuses
to load the file if one is out of range, so `python3 i18n/build.py` fails rather than
rendering a card taller than the one beside it. Every card is the same card; that is the
whole point of the wheel.
Three fields carry judgement rather than fact, and they are the ones to get right:
role      organiza | colabora | asiste  -- what MULTITEC did here. Claiming to have
run somebody else's event is the one thing this section must not do. The
EPS runs UAGames DevCon; GDG Alicante runs its own meetups and we
co-organise them; ONKLUB's hackathon we merely entered.
audience  publico | socios -- a members' event has no sign-up link and never will.
link      null is fine, and normal. Do not invent a URL to fill the field.
The time after T may be 00:00, which means the start time is not recorded anywhere.
The card then prints the date without a time instead of inventing one.
Source of truth for the research behind every row:
quantumpc-management-agent/docs/research/eventos-multitec/EVENTS.md
Procedure for adding one: .claude/skills/multitec-events/SKILL.md
Only events that are CONFIRMED and complete live here. The research dataset holds 64;
these are the nine that had a date to the day, a description and a real photograph on
2026-08-31. The rest arrive as their gaps are closed.
